description: Clear, stated response/style preferences — the model should capture them as global preferences, not as one-message model rules.

conversation.content: Quick meta note: please keep answers short. Bullet points over paragraphs when there's more than one item.
And I hate being called 'buddy' or 'friend'. Just use my name, Devin, or nothing.
Also I prefer metric units for everything, and 24-hour time.

expected.note: Prefers concise answers, bullets for lists.
Dislikes pet names; use name Devin.

anchors: always keep it short as a rule
traps.note: A standing preference is a memory, not a global always-on directive.
